The first-time user should immediately find the input, understand the takeaway, and know how to ask the next question. Do not rebuild the busy research console.

One 720px desktop reading column; 20px mobile side padding. Keep body text at 16–18px. Use a direct takeaway and zero or one useful visual—not a mandatory report template. Keep dates, missing inputs and material uncertainty beside the answer.
Use the shared Noir tokens and 8/10/12/14px radii. History starts closed. Do not turn the source panel into a permanent second column.

Sources and Inputs & math use one temporary drawer or mobile sheet. Opening either makes no research call. Sources remain answer-bound snapshots. Keep the answer, reading position, scope and draft. For 65–66, reuse R2 13: RT assumptions/limits, QN exact values and RI unknowns, plus the current target-margin equation. Use the 42/51 Close and Back controls. In production, content scrolls between them; Close/Escape restores trigger focus. Only the top dialog is active; late closes cannot unlock a newer one. Paper states are static.

Reuse Brain, renderers, citations, stream/history, identity, permissions, cases and monitors. Keep R7/R8’s facts, calculations, assumptions and unknowns distinct. Go deeper… opens 67–68, the current R2 16 depth/usage review; it never grants source access.

Add context previews permitted scope and keeps drafts. Explain a chart uses it when needed. Neither sends; Send needs text. Disabled scopes make no calls; attachments need a qualified path. Context grants no access and never silently drops rejected evidence. Save… opens review 47–48; Cancel keeps answer and draft. Only a matching identity, case ID, version and save receipt routes to 55–56 as Saved, with monitoring off. Expiry returns to review after sign-in without auto-save. Unknown writes reconcile the original request ID. Case & alerts uses R2 14: separate review, confirmation and receipt before monitoring.

Test whether a new user finds the input, understands the takeaway, opens Sources and returns without losing a draft. Verify keyboard focus, screen-reader labels, mobile keyboard clearance and reflow at 320, 390, tablet and desktop widths.

Test 320px, short viewports, long English/Chinese and 200% text. Keep 44px controls keyboard-safe; preserve draft, caret and reading position. State 59 is static. Stop shows Stopping until cancellation is confirmed, then Research stopped. If completion wins, keep the answer. Preserve verified content and citations. Reuse 63 without source-error/Retry UI unless a source failed; no output means No answer yet. Never auto-send; retry failed sources only. Prove keyboard, scrolling, stale/gapped data, reconnect, save/reopen and monitoring at runtime.
